lessons.title: Voz pasiva
lessons.goal: Cuenta qué se hizo sin decir quién lo hizo
tip: be + participio: The letter was sent. These cars are made in Japan.
Se usa cuando el agente es obvio, desconocido o poco importante.
«By» solo si necesitas mencionar al agente: written by Orwell.

phrases.es: Estos coches se fabrican en Japón
phrases.t: These cars are made in Japan

pair.t: The letter was sent yesterday.
This bridge was built in 1890.

pair.t: These phones are made in China

pair.es: La habitación se limpia cada mañana.
pair.t: The room is cleaned every morning.

lessons.title: Estilo indirecto
lessons.goal: Cuenta lo que otra persona dijo
tip: say + lo que se dice; tell + a quién: He told me… / He said that…
Backshift: am → was, will → would, can → could, have done → had done.
Cambian las referencias: today → that day, tomorrow → the next day.

phrases.es: Me contó que había vivido en Canadá
phrases.t: She told me she had lived in Canada
They said they would come later

pair.t: She said she was tired.
He told me he was busy.

exercises.solution: He said he would arrive soon

pair.t: He said he would arrive soon

Me dijo que terminaría el informe.
Me dijo que está terminando el informe.

pair.es: Me dijo que había terminado el informe.
pair.t: She told me she had finished the report.

exercises.explain: Presente → pasado en el estilo indirecto.

lessons.title: Tercera condicional
lessons.goal: Expresa arrepentimientos y críticas sobre el pasado
tip: If + had + participio, would have + participio.
If I had studied, I would have passed = Si hubiera estudiado, habría aprobado.
Negativo: If we hadn't left late… (si no hubiéramos salido tarde…).

phrases.t: If I had studied, I would have passed

phrases.es: Si no hubiéramos salido tarde, no habríamos perdido el tren
phrases.t: If we hadn't left late, we wouldn't have missed the train

bring up = sacar un tema; carry out = llevar a cabo; break out = estallar (una guerra).
